job.title: [Post] We're Hiring – SAP Hybris Technical Lead Ref Code: DS26 Experience: 7 ... looking for an e…

tailoring.headline: SAP Hybris Senior Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and microservices. Proven track record designing and optimizing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, API migrations, and data pipelines. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and production support. Strong techno-functional consultant bridging business analysis, user story creation, and agile delivery, leveraging AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Hybris Technical Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) expertise, honed at Rockwell Automation and Shell, to drive your e-commerce platform forward. Your focus on innovative, scalable Hybris solutions aligns perfectly with my track record of delivering robust integrations and API migrations.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Designed and delivered OCC REST Web Services and microservice APIs on SAP Hybris 2211, enabling seamless headless commerce and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Built end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring accurate product data across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Technical Delivery
bullets.text: Led CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker and Kubernetes, improving release reliability and cloud scalability.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs, and production-ready solutions, leveraging AI-assisted analysis.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: I admire your commitment to pushing the boundaries of SAP Hybris technology and delivering world-class e-commerce experiences. Your emphasis on scalable, AI-enhanced solutions resonates with my own work driving API migrations and data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Joining your team would allow me to apply my deep Hybris expertise to help shape innovative, customer-centric platforms at a leading organization.
tailoring.motivation_short: Passionate about advancing SAP Hybris platforms, I seek to leverage my 5+ years of integration and API expertise to help your company deliver cutting-edge e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Hybris developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to discuss how my API and integration experience can add value to your Technical Lead role. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Hybris Technical Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Hybris Technical Lead position. I bring over five years of hands-on experience with SAP Commerce Cloud, API development, and large-scale integrations, and I am eager to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Thank you for your consideration.
